items.t: Nestlé sued in Texas over arsenic, lead in baby food
items.d: According to the Texas Attorney General, Gerber’s internal tests revealed “dangerous levels” of arsenic and lead in its baby food products.

items.t: Nestlé doubles investment in Mexico to $2B
items.d: The Nescafé maker said the additional $1 billion will allow the food giant to tap into the country’s growth opportunities.

items.t: Nestlé earmarks more cash for Mexico
items.d: The Swiss giant is part-way through spending $1bn up to the end of 2027 and says it will plough another billion into its Mexican operations.
